title: Filtered colimits of quasi-coherent algebras; sections over affines
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a directed set and $(\mathcal A_i,\varphi_{i'i})$ ($i\le i'$) a directed system of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebras (sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras, quasi-coherent as $\mathcal O_S$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]). Then the colimit $\mathcal A=\varinjlim_i\mathcal A_i$ exists in the category of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] (it is the sheafification of the presheaf colimit $U\mapsto\varinjlim_i\mathcal A_i(U)$, and also the colimit in all sheaves of $\mathcal O_S$-algebras), and for every affine open $U\subseteq S$ the canonical map $\varinjlim_i\mathcal A_i(U)\to\mathcal A(U)$ is an isomorphism of rings. Moreover the formation of $\mathcal A$ commutes with restriction to an open $V\subseteq S$: $\mathcal A|_V=\varinjlim_i(\mathcal A_i|_V)$.

proof.text: Take the chosen presheaf-ring colimit p of the underlying presheaf diagram. Evaluation preserves colimits in functor categories, so every evaluated cocone p(U) is a ring colimit. Apply sheafAlgebras_directed_colimit to obtain the algebra cocone c, its algebra universal property, its underlying module universal property, and the equality of its legs with the sheafified legs of p. Its underlying sheaf is definitionally the sheafification of p, so the requested comparison is the identity isomorphism.

Apply quasiCoherentModuleColimitAffineSections to the diagram F followed by commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor and to the module colimit just obtained. Its stage hypotheses are definitionally hF. This proves quasi-coherence of c.pt, and on each affine U supplies surjectivity of the section coprojections and the assertion that a stage section mapped to zero vanishes at a later stage.

For an affine U, let D be the ring diagram of sections and r its cocone with vertex c.pt(U). Let kappa : colim D -> r.pt be the canonical map. For each i and x, kappa(d_i(x)) = r_i(x) by the colimit factorization identity. The section-surjectivity assertion of the preceding step therefore proves surjectivity of kappa.

source.place: Lemma 01ID and Lemma 01HV (2); the canonical section comparison

proof.text: For injectivity, it suffices for the ring map kappa to have trivial kernel. Write a kernel element as d_i(x), using stage representatives for filtered ring colimits. The factorization identity gives r_i(x)=0. The module-colimit assertion from Step 2 gives j >= i with D(i -> j)(x)=0; the module maps and the ring section maps have definitionally identical underlying functions. Naturality of d gives d_i(x)=d_j(D(i -> j)(x))=d_j(0)=0. Thus kappa is bijective, hence an isomorphism of rings. IsColimit.ofPointIso transports the chosen ring colimit to r.

proof.text: For every open V, Over.forgetAdjStar V and Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous give an adjunction whose left functor is definitionally the open-site restriction overPullback. The Under.post functor of a left adjoint is a left adjoint (Under.isLeftAdjoint_post). Consequently Under.post overPullback preserves colimits, and isColimitOfPreserves applied to the algebra colimit c proves the restriction clause directly.

split_report.summary: Split into five steps. The algebra part (existence, sheafification of the presheaf colimit, universal property among sheaves of O_S-algebras, underlying module = colimit in Mod(O_S)) is the new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebras-directed-colimit (Sheaves 009E(3), 0087, Modules 01AH; no sheaf-of-algebras notion in Mathlib). Restriction to opens: new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ⊣ pushforward, isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor), plus the elementary fact that a bijective algebra map is an isomorphism. Affine opens: new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction (tilde.adjunction, unit iso, isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent, left adjoints preserve colimits) gives A|_U ≅ (colim M_i)~ (Schemes 01ID via 01I7) and sections = colim M_i; the comparison with the ring colimit uses the reviewed leaf lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise (2). Quasi-coherence and the colimit among quasi-coherent algebras are elementary (definition pqf-def-coherent; full subcategory). Sheaves 009F/Sites 0738 (sections of directed colimits over qc opens) is not needed: the affine sections come from M~. Stmt deps def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category and def-weil-pbc-sheafification added (the statement uses O_S-modules and sheafification).

lean.statement: theorem quasiCoherentAlgebra_colimit (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (F : I ⥤ X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (hF : ∀ i : I, X.IsQuasiCoherentAlgebra (F.obj i)) : ∃ (c : Cocone F), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ X.IsQuasiCoherentAlgebra c.pt ∧ (∃ (p : Cocone (F ⋙ Under.forget X.sheaf ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat)), Nonempty (IsColimit p) ∧ ∃ (e : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat).obj p.pt ≅ c.pt.right), ∀ i : I, p.ι.app i ≫ toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) p.pt ≫ e.hom.hom = (c.ι.app i).right.hom) ∧ (∀ (U : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → Nonempty (IsColimit (((evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ CommRingCat).obj (op U)).mapCocone ((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat).mapCocone ((Under.forget X.sheaf).mapCocone c))))) ∧ (∀ (V : X.Opens), Nonempty (IsColimit ((Under.post ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).overPullback CommRingCat V)).mapCocone c)))
